description:
SONARITHM is an open-source application and framework that turns graphs, charts and numerical data into structured, navigable sound. A declarative sonification specification is compiled into a canonical intermediate representation (the Score) and rendered by one deterministic Rust core, shared by a command-line tool, Python bindings and, later, a desktop application. Its design defaults are traced to published auditory-display and accessibility research, and every render carries a provenance manifest (software and engine versions, spec hash, data fingerprint) so that results can be reproduced.

Code is licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; documentation and example datasets are licensed CC BY 4.0.
